# Filter the row for "Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps"
outside_row = df[df['Description Losses'] == 'Deaths Outside of Prisons & Camps']

# Extract the year columns (excluding 'Description Losses' and 'Total')
year_columns = [col for col in df.columns if col not in ['Description Losses', 'Total']]

# Get the values for the outside row across the years
outside_values = outside_row[year_columns].iloc[0]

# Find the year with the maximum value
max_year = outside_values.idxmax()

# The answer is the year (as a string)
answer = max_year
